WITH sections AS (
SELECT 'schemas' AS section, coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY value::text COLLATE "C"),'[]'::jsonb) AS entries FROM (SELECT jsonb_build_array(n.nspname,pg_get_userbyid(n.nspowner)) AS value FROM pg_namespace n WHERE n.nspname IN ('genui','genui_private','genui_meta') LIMIT 1025) rows
UNION ALL
SELECT 'schema_acl' AS section, coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY value::text COLLATE "C"),'[]'::jsonb) AS entries FROM (SELECT jsonb_build_array(n.nspname,CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END,a.privilege_type,a.is_grantable) AS value FROM pg_namespace n CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(coalesce(n.nspacl,acldefault('n',n.nspowner))) a WHERE n.nspname IN ('genui','genui_private','genui_meta') LIMIT 1025) rows
UNION ALL
SELECT 'relations' AS section, coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY value::text COLLATE "C"),'[]'::jsonb) AS entries FROM (SELECT jsonb_build_array(n.nspname,c.relname,c.relkind::text,pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner),c.relrowsecurity,c.relforcerowsecurity,c.relpersistence::text,c.relispartition,c.reloptions) AS value FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('genui','genui_private','genui_meta') LIMIT 1025) rows
UNION ALL
SELECT 'columns' AS section, coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY value::text COLLATE "C"),'[]'::jsonb) AS entries FROM (SELECT jsonb_build_array(n.nspname,c.relname,a.attnum,a.attname,format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),a.attnotnull,a.attidentity::text,a.attgenerated::text,a.attisdropped,left(pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid),8193),CASE WHEN a.attcollation=0 THEN NULL ELSE a.attcollation::regcollation::text END) AS value FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=a.attrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef d ON d.adrelid=c.oid AND d.adnum=a.attnum WHERE n.nspname IN ('genui','genui_private','genui_meta') AND a.attnum>0 AND c.relkind IN ('r','p','v','m','f') LIMIT 1025) rows
UNION ALL
SELECT 'constraints' AS section, coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY value::text COLLATE "C"),'[]'::jsonb) AS entries FROM (SELECT jsonb_build_array(n.nspname,coalesce(c.relname,t.typname),k.conname,k.contype::text,k.convalidated,k.condeferrable,k.condeferred,left(pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid,true),8193)) AS value FROM pg_constraint k JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=k.connamespace LEFT JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=k.conrelid LEFT JOIN pg_type t ON t.oid=k.contypid WHERE n.nspname IN ('genui','genui_private','genui_meta') LIMIT 1025) rows
UNION ALL
SELECT 'indexes' AS section, coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY value::text COLLATE "C"),'[]'::jsonb) AS entries FROM (SELECT jsonb_build_array(n.nspname,c.relname,i.indisunique,i.indisprimary,i.indisvalid,i.indisready,i.indislive,i.indisexclusion,i.indnullsnotdistinct,left(pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid),8193)) AS value FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=i.indexrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('genui','genui_private','genui_meta') LIMIT 1025) rows
UNION ALL
SELECT 'policies' AS section, coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY value::text COLLATE "C"),'[]'::jsonb) AS entries FROM (SELECT jsonb_build_array(n.nspname,c.relname,p.polname,p.polcmd::text,p.polpermissive,(SELECT jsonb_agg(CASE WHEN r=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(r) END ORDER BY CASE WHEN r=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(r) END COLLATE "C") FROM unnest(p.polroles) r),left(pg_get_expr(p.polqual,p.polrelid),8193),left(pg_get_expr(p.polwithcheck,p.polrelid),8193)) AS value FROM pg_policy p JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=p.polrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('genui','genui_private','genui_meta') LIMIT 1025) rows
UNION ALL
SELECT 'table_acl' AS section, coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY value::text COLLATE "C"),'[]'::jsonb) AS entries FROM (SELECT jsonb_build_array(n.nspname,c.relname,CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END,a.privilege_type,a.is_grantable) AS value FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(coalesce(c.relacl,acldefault(CASE WHEN c.relkind='S' THEN 's'::"char" ELSE 'r'::"char" END,c.relowner))) a WHERE n.nspname IN ('genui','genui_private','genui_meta') AND c.relkind IN ('r','p','v','m','f','S') LIMIT 1025) rows
UNION ALL
SELECT 'column_acl' AS section, coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY value::text COLLATE "C"),'[]'::jsonb) AS entries FROM (SELECT jsonb_build_array(n.nspname,c.relname,d.attname,CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END,a.privilege_type,a.is_grantable) AS value FROM pg_attribute d JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=d.attrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(d.attacl) a WHERE n.nspname IN ('genui','genui_private','genui_meta') LIMIT 1025) rows
UNION ALL
SELECT 'functions' AS section, coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY value::text COLLATE "C"),'[]'::jsonb) AS entries FROM (SELECT jsonb_build_array(n.nspname,p.proname,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid),pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),p.prokind::text,p.prosecdef,p.proleakproof,p.proisstrict,p.provolatile::text,p.proparallel::text,p.proconfig,CASE WHEN p.prokind='a' THEN 'unexpected aggregate' ELSE left(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),65537) END) AS value FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('genui','genui_private','genui_meta') LIMIT 1025) rows
UNION ALL
SELECT 'function_acl' AS section, coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY value::text COLLATE "C"),'[]'::jsonb) AS entries FROM (SELECT jsonb_build_array(n.nspname,p.proname,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid),CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END,a.privilege_type,a.is_grantable) AS value FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(coalesce(p.proacl,acldefault('f',p.proowner))) a WHERE n.nspname IN ('genui','genui_private','genui_meta') LIMIT 1025) rows
UNION ALL
SELECT 'types' AS section, coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY value::text COLLATE "C"),'[]'::jsonb) AS entries FROM (SELECT jsonb_build_array(n.nspname,t.typname,pg_get_userbyid(t.typowner),t.typtype::text,CASE WHEN t.typbasetype=0 THEN NULL ELSE format_type(t.typbasetype,t.typtypmod) END,t.typnotnull,left(t.typdefault,8193),CASE WHEN t.typelem=0 THEN NULL ELSE t.typelem::regtype::text END) AS value FROM pg_type t JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.typnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('genui','genui_private','genui_meta') LIMIT 1025) rows
UNION ALL
SELECT 'type_acl' AS section, coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY value::text COLLATE "C"),'[]'::jsonb) AS entries FROM (SELECT jsonb_build_array(n.nspname,t.typname,CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END,a.privilege_type,a.is_grantable) AS value FROM pg_type t JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.typnamespace CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(coalesce(t.typacl,acldefault('T',t.typowner))) a WHERE n.nspname IN ('genui','genui_private','genui_meta') LIMIT 1025) rows
UNION ALL
SELECT 'triggers' AS section, coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY value::text COLLATE "C"),'[]'::jsonb) AS entries FROM (SELECT jsonb_build_array(n.nspname,c.relname,t.tgname,t.tgenabled::text,left(pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid,true),8193)) AS value FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('genui','genui_private','genui_meta') AND NOT t.tgisinternal LIMIT 1025) rows
UNION ALL
SELECT 'rules' AS section, coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY value::text COLLATE "C"),'[]'::jsonb) AS entries FROM (SELECT jsonb_build_array(n.nspname,c.relname,r.rulename,r.ev_enabled::text,left(pg_get_ruledef(r.oid,true),8193)) AS value FROM pg_rewrite r JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=r.ev_class JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('genui','genui_private','genui_meta') LIMIT 1025) rows
UNION ALL
SELECT 'roles' AS section, coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY value::text COLLATE "C"),'[]'::jsonb) AS entries FROM (SELECT jsonb_build_array(r.rolname,r.rolsuper,r.rolcreatedb,r.rolcreaterole,r.rolreplication,r.rolbypassrls,r.rolcanlogin,r.rolinherit,r.rolconnlimit,r.rolvaliduntil::text,r.rolconfig) AS value FROM pg_roles r WHERE r.rolname IN ('genui_owner','genui_lock','genui_workspace','genui_control','genui_data','genui_worker') LIMIT 1025) rows
UNION ALL
SELECT 'memberships' AS section, coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY value::text COLLATE "C"),'[]'::jsonb) AS entries FROM (SELECT jsonb_build_array(r.rolname,m.rolname,a.admin_option,a.inherit_option,a.set_option) AS value FROM pg_auth_members a JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid=a.roleid JOIN pg_roles m ON m.oid=a.member WHERE (r.rolname IN ('genui_owner','genui_lock','genui_workspace','genui_control','genui_data','genui_worker') OR m.rolname IN ('genui_owner','genui_lock','genui_workspace','genui_control','genui_data','genui_worker')) AND NOT (m.rolname='genui_migration' AND r.rolname IN ('genui_owner','genui_lock','genui_workspace','genui_control','genui_data','genui_worker') AND a.admin_option AND NOT a.inherit_option AND NOT a.set_option) LIMIT 1025) rows
UNION ALL
SELECT 'effective_boundaries' AS section, coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY value::text COLLATE "C"),'[]'::jsonb) AS entries FROM (SELECT jsonb_build_array(r.rolname,has_database_privilege(r.oid,current_database(),'CONNECT'),has_database_privilege(r.oid,current_database(),'CREATE'),has_database_privilege(r.oid,current_database(),'TEMP'),has_schema_privilege(r.oid,'public','CREATE'),has_parameter_privilege(r.oid,'session_replication_role','SET'),has_parameter_privilege(r.oid,'session_replication_role','ALTER SYSTEM')) AS value FROM pg_roles r WHERE r.rolname IN ('genui_owner','genui_lock','genui_workspace','genui_control','genui_data','genui_worker') LIMIT 1025) rows
UNION ALL
SELECT 'role_database_settings' AS section, coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY value::text COLLATE "C"),'[]'::jsonb) AS entries FROM (SELECT jsonb_build_array(coalesce(r.rolname,'ALL_ROLES'),coalesce(d.datname,'*'),s.setconfig) AS value FROM pg_db_role_setting s LEFT JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid=s.setrole LEFT JOIN pg_database d ON d.oid=s.setdatabase WHERE (r.rolname IN ('genui_owner','genui_lock','genui_workspace','genui_control','genui_data','genui_worker') AND (s.setdatabase=0 OR d.datname=current_database())) OR (s.setrole=0 AND d.datname=current_database()) LIMIT 1025) rows
UNION ALL
SELECT 'default_acl' AS section, coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY value::text COLLATE "C"),'[]'::jsonb) AS entries FROM (SELECT jsonb_build_array(r.rolname,coalesce(n.nspname,'*'),d.defaclobjtype::text,CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END,a.privilege_type,a.is_grantable) AS value FROM pg_default_acl d JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid=d.defaclrole LEFT JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=d.defaclnamespace CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(d.defaclacl) a WHERE r.rolname IN ('genui_owner','genui_lock') OR n.nspname IN ('genui','genui_private','genui_meta') LIMIT 1025) rows
UNION ALL
SELECT 'role_reachability' AS section, coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY value::text COLLATE "C"),'[]'::jsonb) AS entries FROM (SELECT jsonb_build_array(r.rolname,parent.rolname) AS value FROM pg_roles r CROSS JOIN pg_roles parent WHERE r.rolname IN ('genui_owner','genui_lock','genui_workspace','genui_control','genui_data','genui_worker') AND r.oid<>parent.oid AND pg_has_role(r.oid,parent.oid,'MEMBER') LIMIT 1025) rows
UNION ALL
SELECT 'internal_triggers' AS section, coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY value::text COLLATE "C"),'[]'::jsonb) AS entries FROM (SELECT jsonb_build_array(n.nspname,c.relname,k.conname,t.tgfoid::regprocedure::text,t.tgtype,t.tgenabled::text,t.tgdeferrable,t.tginitdeferred) AS value FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_constraint k ON k.oid=t.tgconstraint WHERE n.nspname IN ('genui','genui_private','genui_meta') AND t.tgisinternal LIMIT 1025) rows
), result AS (SELECT jsonb_object_agg(section,entries)::text AS body FROM sections)
SELECT CASE WHEN octet_length(body)<=262144 THEN body ELSE NULL END FROM result
